definition: The task of automatically producing an answer to a natural language question, either by extracting it from a given passage or generating it from learned knowledge.
details: Question answering systems range from extractive QA (finding the answer span within a provided document) to open-domain QA (retrieving and reasoning over external sources) to closed-book QA (answering purely from a model's parametric knowledge).
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Question Answering.
